Iran strikes damaged hundreds of structures at US bases globally

Iranian strikes have damaged or destroyed hundreds of structures at U.S. bases across eight countries, according to a Pentagon watchdog report. The report details the extent of the damage caused by Iranian attacks on facilities used by the United States.
